1: This 6-week program is designed to help climbers begin their finger strength training journey. This program is suitable for anyone without previous training experience who would like to progress in climbing. This training schedule is not suitable if you are already climbing 4 or more days per week.
A max hang style workout designed for climbers building up to body weight hangs
A repeater style workout designed for climbers building up to body weight hangs - Feet on the ground
10 sets of heavy flexor curls with minimal rest
8 sets of heavy finger curls with minimal rest
Shoulder shrugs using a pull up bar
